leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a todo list interface with HTML elements for input and display
Initialize and manipulate an array to store todo items in JavaScript
Implement functions to create, read, update, and delete todo items
Bind event handlers to user interactions for adding and removing todos
Render the todo list dynamically by updating the DOM based on array state
Configure persistent storage using localStorage to save todo items
Apply validation to prevent empty todos from being added to the list
lessonTitle: Build a todo list CRUD app in JavaScript
